name: Infantile Leukocyte Adhesion Deficiency-like Disease Due to RAC2 Deficiency
aliases: LAD-like Immunodeficiency Caused by RAC2 Mutation

criteria.description: Identification of pathogenic biallelic mutations in the RAC2 gene
Demonstration of neutrophil chemotaxis and adhesion defects in functional assays
Recurrent severe bacterial infections with impaired wound healing in infancy
Abnormal neutrophil morphology and reduced oxidative burst activity

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of biallelic RAC2 mutations plus clinical immunodeficiency with neutrophil functional defects
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of genetic, clinical, and functional neutrophil testing.

searchTerms: slow or poor healing of wounds

laboratory: Neutrophil functional assays showing impaired chemotaxis and adhesion
Reduced oxidative burst activity in neutrophils
imaging: Radiologic evidence of recurrent pneumonia or osteomyelitis
Soft tissue abscesses on ultrasound or MRI
other: Poor wound healing and recurrent skin infections

distinguishingFeatures: Absent or reduced CD18 expression on neutrophils

redFlags: Recurrent severe bacterial infections starting in early infancy
Delayed separation of the umbilical cord beyond 3 weeks
Poor wound healing with persistent soft tissue infections
references: Almarza Novoa et al., 'RAC2 deficiency: a novel cause of leukocyte adhesion deficiency-like immunodeficiency', J Clin Immunol, 2021
Orphanet Report on Infantile LAD-like disease due to RAC2 deficiency, ORPHA:183707
Wang et al., 'Functional characterization of RAC2 mutations in immunodeficiency', Blood, 2020
